hypothesis_specification.framework: Paired one-sided non-inferiority test for distress recall
hypothesis_specification.test_statistic_formula: Z = ( (R_cand - R_base) + delta ) / sqrt( (p_disc - d^2) / N_D )

spending_function_clarification.clarification_notes: The Lan-DeMets sfLDOF spending function incorporates Brownian motion reflection principle (factor of 2). To spend exactly alpha=0.05 at horizon t=1, the argument must evaluate to Z_{0.025} = 1.95996. This design is deliberately conservative at early looks, spending only 0.000687 at t=1/3 (compared to 0.001533 under classical discrete OBF and 0.002187 under unreflected Formula C), thereby preserving the bulk of statistical power for final confirmatory assessment.

deterministic_numerical_quadrature.method: Exact numerical integration of multivariate Gaussian Brownian increments via Markov transition

reproducible_monte_carlo_validation.methodological_disclosure: Monte Carlo simulation produces an empirical estimate with standard error SE = 0.000069, not a deterministic mathematical proof. Mathematical exactness is established by deterministic numerical integration (quadrature), which yields Z = [3.2001, 2.1408, 1.6948] with exact alpha = 0.050000.
